    n.n_name,

    s.s_phone,
    s.s_comment
FROM

JOIN

JOIN
    supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN

SELECT
          n.n_name AS supp_nation,
          n2.n_name AS cust_nation,
          EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS l_year,
          SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
        FROM lineitem l
        JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
        JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
        JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
        JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
        JOIN nation n2 ON c.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
        WHERE n.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY')
          AND n2.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY')
          AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
          AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
        GROUP BY n.n_name, n2.n_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)
        ORDER BY n.n_name, n2.n_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)

JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
WHERE s.s_phone SUBSTR(s.s_phone, 1, 2) IN ('13', '31', '23', '29', '30', '18', '17')
    AND c.c_acctbal > (SELECT SUM(c2.c_acctbal) FROM customer c2 
                            JOIN nation n2 ON c2.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey 
                            WHERE n2.n_name = n.n_name AND n2.n_name = n.n_name)
    AND c.c_custkey NOT IN (
        SELECT o.o_custkey 
        FROM orders o 
        WHERE o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    )
GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name
ORDER BY n.n_name
LIMIT 100;
